business_problem: Children 1st offers whole-family support across Scotland to ensure children are safe, secure, and loved. The nonprofit needed to update its CRM so frontline workers can better record and use up-to-date information.
solution_summary: Children 1st offers whole-family support across Scotland to ensure children are safe, secure, and loved. The nonprofit needed to update its CRM so frontline workers can better record and use up-to-date information. With Dynamics 365, Children 1st tracks current cases, empowers frontline staff to spend more time building relationships with families, and measures impact to communicate with supporters. After ruling out off-the-shelf solutions or developing one themselves, leadership landed on Dynamics 365 Customer Service. Scouller noted that Dynamics 365 would integrate with the other Microsoft cloud-based solutions they already used, and the IT team was committed to becoming experts in Microsoft solutions. Children 1st turned to Microsoft partner Kerv Digital to spearhead the transition to Dynamics 365, calling the effort the Recording Our Work Project.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
solution_components.role: Provides the service and case-management workspace where staff track interactions, tasks, and outcomes.

solution_components.name: Power Apps
solution_components.role: Delivers low-code apps that capture frontline inputs and guide workflow steps.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Publishes dashboards and reports so teams can track trends, KPIs, and operational status.

business_outcome: “We can now communicate what children and families tell us, what they experience,” Scouller says. “It helps us show why whole-family support is so important. We simply can’t do that if we don’t have the right data.”
architecture_clues: Case and outcome data is captured in Dynamics 365 Customer Service, enriched through Power Apps relationship mapping, and then flowed into Power BI so staff and leaders can track risk, trends, and impact reporting.

After ruling out off-the-shelf solutions or developing one themselves, leadership landed on Dynamics 365 Customer Service. Scouller noted that Dynamics 365 would integrate with the other Microsoft cloud-based solutions they already used, and the IT team was committed to becoming experts in Microsoft solutions. Children 1st turned to Microsoft partner Kerv Digital to spearhead the transition to Dynamics 365, calling the effort the Recording Our Work Project.

The Dynamics 365 system also incorporates Microsoft Power Apps that allow families to make a visual map of important relationships, such as siblings, grandparents, or teachers, to communicate and work with their family support workers. Ultimately, records that reflect complex webs of relationships empower staff to better help children.

Data collected in Dynamics 365 automatically flows into Power BI. “These reports give us really good visibility of trends,” such as how many families are being supported across Scotland, Scouller explains. The up-to-date information enables leadership to make informed decisions, like where to direct resources or work more closely with partner organizations. That way, the nonprofit can meet the needs of families and adjust to changing circumstances, faster.
